dimensions: bo 10, be 100.¹ My meas.: mp ****rcvr 11.7, slide exit 10.1, bore cannot be measured; slide sec. 1621 (allowing for present extension of frozen slide), overlap 36, bell sec. 1051, total le 2636; bell entry 12.3, neck-pipe at bell-bow (ext.) 12.9, bell-pipe at bell-bow 12.9 (ext.), be 102.5
remarks: 16761 and 16762 are very similar. One of the pair was formerly fitted with a slide handle.² **** Tubular slide stays; immoveable stay telescopic, dragon-scale pattern on moveable stay; immoveable stay has same pattern, but shows more wear. Ferrules immediately adjacent to slide stays have dragon-scale pattern, others have rings. Slide is stuck approx. halfway between 2nd and 3rd pos., thus bore cannot be measured. Slide-bow has no ring; small dents in bow; guard on bottom of bow, slightly off-center, 51mm long, perhaps orig. Crease or dent 371mm from bell opening, joint in tube here also. One flat bell stay with pin in attached hinge; eyelet in bell stay; one eyelet nearer bell-pipe side; floral pattern on proximal surface with letters “MAR”; reverse of bell-stay has same pattern, with letters “HIS”. Engraved floral pattern on garland, similar  but not identical to Nuremberg instruments—flowers are smaller. Ferrules in bell sec. match those in slide sec., excluding sleeve at bell stay; flat-edged rim-wire visible from inside bell. Examined by the author, June 1999.
